title: Emergent phases of superposition: from partial to full representation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are thought to represent features by vectors in a hidden space of dimension given by the model's width. Superposition, in which more features are represented than the width by letting representation vectors overlap, is a leading account of how representation vectors are organized. However, how model width and data statistics determine the configuration of representation vectors and the resulting loss when the number of features and the width are large remains less understood. Here we show, in Anthropic's toy model of superposition, that increasing the width drives a continuous phase transition from a partial-representation phase, where only a subset of features receives appreciable representation vectors while the rest vanish, to a full-representation phase, where every feature is represented. translated_title: 叠加的涌现相变：从部分表示到完全表示
translated_abstract: 人们认为，大语言模型通过在维度由模型宽度决定的隐藏空间中的向量来表示特征。叠加，即通过让表示向量相互重叠来表示超出宽度的更多特征，是关于表示向量如何组织的一种主流解释。然而，当特征数量和模型宽度都很大时，模型宽度与数据统计如何决定表示向量的构型以及由此产生的损失，目前仍知之甚少。在本文中，我们在Anthropic的叠加玩具模型中表明，增加模型宽度会驱动一个连续相变：从部分表示相（只有一部分特征获得可观的表示向量，其余特征的表示向量消失）过渡到完全表示相（每个特征都被表示）。我们基于部分随机投影近似所建立的理论做出了预测，并得到实验证实：临界宽度随特征数量的增长而增长。
tldr: 该论文发现，在Anthropic的叠加玩具模型中，随着模型宽度的增加，会发生从“部分表示相”（仅一部分特征被表示）到“完全表示相”（所有特征均被表示）的连续相变，并通过部分随机投影近似理论成功预测了临界宽度的增长规律。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a continuous phase transition in Anthropic's toy model of superposition, where increasing model width drives a shift from a partial-representation phase to a full-representation phase, with a partial random projection theory predicting how the critical width grows with the number of features.
